<!-- thm-1: body_md -->
\label{thm1}
For all $k\in\mathbb N,\, m\in\mathbb Z$, the ideal $\mathcal J_m\subset\mathcal A $ is $\partial_{t_k}$-stable, and
\begin{equation}\label{lammt}
    \partial_{t_k}(\Lambda_m)-[A^{(k)},\Lambda_m]\in\mathcal J_m[\mathcal S,\mathcal S^{-1}].
\end{equation}
<!-- end thm-1 -->
<!-- lemma-1: body_md -->
\label{lem+} Let $L=\mathcal S+u\mathcal S^{-1}$  (\ref{laxVol}). Then
\begin{equation*}\label{lemstat}
    [\pi_+(L^n\mathcal S^{-m})\mathcal S^m,L]=
   (\mathcal S-1) ( \ell(n,m-2))\mathcal S^{m-1}  +
    (\mathcal S-1)(\ell(n,m-1))\mathcal S^{m  } .
\end{equation*}
<!-- end lemma-1 -->
